content: {"paper_id":"W7163222908","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"deep-clustering","exact_quote":"Clustering is performed via a self-training objective on the refined embeddings.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"在GAT学习得到的精炼嵌入上执行聚类，并使用自训练目标，属于可学习的神经表示加聚类目标。"},{"keyword_id":"dimensionality-reduction","exact_quote":"The model first projects high-dimensional data onto a fixed SOM grid, generating prototypes enriched with local density and variance statistics.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"显式将高维数据投影到固定SOM低维网格并生成原型，体现低维映射与维度压缩。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-neural-networks","exact_quote":"A sparse graph constructed from the lattice topology enables subsequent GAT layers to refine these prototypes through learnable attention weights.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"使用GAT图注意力层在稀疏图上进行可学习消息传递以精炼表示，符合图神经网络定义。"},{"keyword_id":"pseudo-label-self-training","exact_quote":"Clustering is performed via a self-training objective on the refined embeddings.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确采用self-training目标进行聚类，即以模型当前输出或聚类预测作为后续训练信号。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","reason_zh":"摘要说明图由SOM格子拓扑构造、GAT学习注意力权重，但未明确学习或修正样本间边、邻接矩阵；固定图上的注意力不充分。"},{"keyword_id":"noisy-label-learning","reason_zh":"仅提到在20% label noise下保持聚类性能，未表明训练监督中存在错误标签并将其作为研究条件；更像鲁棒性评估而非噪声标签学习。"}],"input_issues":[]}
